project_info.architecture_type: Data Lake Architecture with ETL Pipeline
external_dependencies: External Sources (Public Data Sets, Research Partners)
project_info.network_architecture: Multi-tier cloud architecture with segregated zones: (1) External data sources connected via VPN/Direct Connect and SFTP, (2) Ingestion layer for data intake, (3) Data Lake layer with raw, curated, and analytics storage tiers in S3, (4) Analytics and query layer with data warehousing and ad-hoc query capabilities, (5) Presentation layer with BI tools, custom apps, and ML services, (6) Management & Security layer providing centralized governance across all layers
key_components: Ingest Layer (Amazon AppFlow, AWS Transfer for SFTP, AWS Snow Family, Amazon HealthLake, AWS DMS, AWS Data Exchange)
Data Lake Storage (Amazon S3 with Raw, Curated, and Analytics tiers)
Data Cataloging (AWS Glue Crawlers, AWS Glue Data Catalog, AWS Lake Formation)
Data Warehousing (Amazon Redshift Data Warehouses and Data Marts)
Machine Learning Platform (Amazon EC2, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon EFS/FSx, Amazon RDS)
Management & Security Layer (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Macie, Config, CloudTrail, CloudWatch)
